title: Contact
description: Reach the Cortexplor newsroom: tips, corrections and press.

body.text: The official contact channel for Cortexplor is contato@cortexplor.com.

items: Correction: send the story link and the specific point to fix. These get priority.
Story tip: tell us the fact and where it was published or announced.
Press and releases: welcome, but a release alone is never a story - it needs independent confirmation.
Advertising: we monetise through ad networks and do not sell sponsored content.

body.text: We read everything. Corrections are answered within two business days; other subjects as the newsroom's schedule allows.
